SQLAddressAfter.defaultValue:
'SELECT DISTINCT
    SBAD.HIST_CREATE_DTM,
    SBAD.SBSB_CK,
    SBAD.SBAD_TYPE,
    SBAD.SBAD_ADDR1,
    SBAD.SBAD_ADDR2,
    SBAD.SBAD_ADDR3,
    SBAD.SBAD_CITY,
    SBAD.SBAD_STATE,
    SBAD.SBAD_ZIP,
    SBAD.SBAD_COUNTY,
    SBAD.SBAD_PHONE,
    SBAD.TXN1_ROW_ID
FROM
    FACETS.AU_CMC_SBAD_ADDR SBAD
    INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME ON MEME.SBSB_CK = SBAD.SBSB_CK
    INNER JOIN FACETS.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE ON MEPE.MEME_CK = MEME.MEME_CK
WHERE
    UPPER(SBAD.HIST_IMAGE_CD) = 'A'
    AND UPPER(SBAD.HIST_LOG_ACT_CD) = 'U'
    AND SBAD.GRGR_CK = 13
    AND MEPE.GRGR_CK = 13
    AND UPPER(SBAD.HIST_USUS_ID) = 'FAAPP'
    AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'Y'
    AND (SYSDATE - 365) BETWEEN MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT
    AND MEPE.CSPI_ID IN (SELECT CSPI_ID FROM AGP.TNLTC_PLANS)
    AND MEPE.CSCS_ID = 'PL02'
    AND SBAD.HIST_CREATE_DTM >= (SYSDATE - 365)
ORDER BY
    SBAD.SBSB_CK, SBAD.SBAD_TYPE, SBAD.HIST_CREATE_DTM, SBAD.TXN1_ROW_ID'
